name: KEMS
tagline: Live reality. Four KEMS products. One clear energy story.
summary: A focused read-only KEMS companion using the exact supplied SVG brand, a live seven-day-delayed public demo, Cloudflare Access property login and local-only Pi management.
build: Alpha7 property dashboard · exact supplied SVG branding · live delayed demo · Cloudflare Access property launcher · self-healing local Tunnel setup · kems.uk source
principles: Home Assistant and KEMS remain the source of truth for each property.
The user-facing product model is Live Data, Battery & Solar, Full KEMS and Full KEMS Agile.
brand/kems-logo.svg is the exact user-supplied KEMS visual source of truth; user-facing SVG copies are byte-identical and are never redrawn.
The property website is read-only and cannot call Home Assistant services.
The public kems.uk site receives no Home Assistant credentials, live control API or precise live household power.
The public demo host exposes only /api/public-demo and publishes deliberately sanitised daily totals delayed by at least seven days.
The public demo feed never includes entity IDs, device identifiers, Home Assistant addresses, credentials or control endpoints.
Private property sign-in is delegated to Cloudflare Access and the KEMS App Launcher; kems.uk stores no separate password database.
Home is always the centre of the energy-flow model.
Live, simulated, shadow and calculated allocation data are visibly labelled.
Full KEMS Agile displays KEMS' current optimiser, horizon, safety and digital-twin proof without creating a hardware write path.
What-if replay is read-only and never changes the active KEMS strategy.
KEMS native period summaries are authoritative for Week, Month, Year and All time.
Raspberry Pi installs and updates are sourced from checksum-verified GitHub releases without touching persistent KEMS data.
Raspberry Pi maintenance, updates, encrypted backups and Cloudflare connector provisioning remain local-only even when a property dashboard is reached through a remote gateway.
Cloudflare connector setup accepts only a tunnel token; pasted shell commands are never executed.
Privileged Cloudflare setup listens only on loopback and is reached through a same-origin KEMS API guarded against Cloudflare and forwarded requests.
Every appliance update converges the local Remote Access helper service and verifies its loopback health before the update is considered complete.
The private property tunnel targets KEMS Web on localhost:4173 only and never exposes Pi management, setup helpers, SSH, Home Assistant or the wider LAN.
The public demo tunnel uses the same KEMS gateway but is host-gated to one sanitised read-only endpoint.
Each property keeps its own Home Assistant credentials and KEMS data on its own appliance.
A KEMS Pi can use an existing Home Assistant or optionally host Home Assistant Container locally.
Remote property access uses an authenticated outbound-tunnel boundary; the public static website is never the Home Assistant proxy.
